title: Retro Release (v1)
description: Schema for release.json at library/releases/retro/<system>/<sha256>/release.json. A release is one exact byte-for-byte artifact (e.g. a specific ROM/ISO dump). Identity is the full raw SHA-256 of that artifact; filenames are aliases only, never identity.

sha256.description: Full raw SHA-256 of the exact release artifact bytes. Must equal the <sha256> directory segment.

filename_aliases.description: All filenames under which this exact byte sequence has been observed. Aliases only — never identity.

game_ref.description: Optional link to the logical retro game (library/games/retro/<system>/<slug>) this release belongs to. Absent until matched.

observed_from.description: Sources this exact release has been observed from, for provenance and re-acquisition.
